whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Best Meal Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has an incredible 4.9★ rating with 29+ reviews in Anandpuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online menu ordering and table inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, daily tiffin/meal highlights, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bestmeal

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Best Meal Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and a showcase of your top-rated meals in Anandpuri, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, photos aur contact setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
